title: Function Health pricing
description: A serif heading with a struck-through terracotta price and a lead line over one large rounded outlined card with a deep soft shadow: badge, plan name, a huge serif price with a small 'per day', a billing note and a full-width pill on the left, a thin divider, and a check-circle list on the right (stacked on phones). Three short member reviews with tiny terracotta stars sit beneath, centred on desktop and in a swipe rail on phones.
notes: reviews are plain text with five stars
